name: Battle of Waterloo
description: 18 June 1815, half past eleven. Wellington holds the ridge of Mont-Saint-Jean with Hougoumont and La Haye Sainte thrown forward of it; Napoleon forms on the ridge of La Belle Alliance, a kilometre of rye and mud between them. Every formation stands where the battlefield surveys put it at that hour. Blucher's Prussians come on through the afternoon, over the Lasne and down the Ohain road.

value.title: Napoleon Sights the Prussians
value.message: A dark column has been made out at Chapelle-Saint-Lambert, three hours' march from the Emperor's right. Soult's despatch to Grouchy is already on the road.

value.title: Bulow Crosses the Lasne
value.message: The head of the Prussian IV Corps is through the defile and into the Bois de Paris, feeling towards Plancenoit on Napoleon's right and rear.

value.title: The Rest of IV Corps Comes Up
value.message: Hake and Ryssel are on the same road behind Losthin, with Bulow's artillery reserve. Thirty thousand Prussians are now east of Plancenoit.

value.title: Pirch Follows Bulow
value.message: The Prussian II Corps is on the Lasne road behind the IV, marching for the wood above Plancenoit.

value.title: Zieten Comes Down the Ohain Road
value.message: The Prussian I Corps is in sight above Smohain, on Wellington's left. The two armies have joined.
